mapper.sql: id, menu_name, parent_id, sort, path, component, icon, permission, menu_type, visible, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id AND rm.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission <> ''
